note: New `createSession()`, `selectSession(id)` and `dropSession(id)` exports on the WASM and native engines: a session is an engine state of its own (numbering, sheet, theme, settings and module resolver), and every call works on the selected one. Session 0 is selected from the start. `selectSession` and `dropSession` throw a `TypeError` for an id that is not an unsigned 32-bit integer, and an `Error` for an unknown session or for dropping session 0
